name: 230-bottom-placement-flips-the-land-layer
why: 220's geometry with the probe moved to the FRONT. The footprint authors this land on F.Cu, and a back-side placement flips it to B.Cu - a layer name is an absolute board fact, not a footprint-local one. So the copper at (8.0, 9.7) is on the bottom and a top-layer end reaches nothing there, however exactly it is aimed. 190 says the same thing for a land already stated on the back; this is the case that fails if the FLIP is what is missing, which is the half a board dict actually depends on: no footprint states B.Cu for a part it does not know will be flipped.
